imaginations.title: Pupil-driven circle
imaginations.image_or_idea: A circular motif whose hue tracks the viewer's own pupil dilation in real time, drifting between blue and green so that no two viewers ever agree on a stable colour.
imaginations.possible_value: Turns the disagreement into the design's content instead of a defect to be settled.
imaginations.test_question: Does disagreement persist, or converge, when viewers see the motif respond to themselves?
